title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Qubasa Castle (Baseball Stadium)
description:
One of the backgrounds used in the castle of Qusara Planet, from Ganbare Goemon 4. This game in specific is themed after various sports, while adding aliens to the mix. Baseball, football, bowling, ski, golf and etc. It reflects even in the enemies and lore. I don't know what this background can be used. The HDMA that the original game uses is also included, insert it with the Uberasm Tool.

Check the readme to insert the layer 3. I got help from MarioFanGamer to make this work, so thanks to him, as well.

WARNING! Incompatible with vanilla status bar! Use with a sprite status bar like the DKCR one or another custom status bar that you may like to use.

Or only use the HDMA, if you don't want to use the layer 3. It's located in the library folder. Also, using only the HDMA, you can use the vanilla status bar or any status bar you want.

Recommendend BG Scroll : None, None. The background doesn't loop, like in the original game.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
